s: Din shechita beyom tob ubo l"ch seipim: en marin sakkin lechakam beyom tob lirot im hi reuya lishchot bah kemo shehaya hamminhag bime chakme hashsha"s, shemma tihyeh peguma veyomar lo sheasur lishchot bah mippene pegimutah veyelek vichaddedenna bemashchezet, venimtza metaqqen keli beyom tob. Abal hechakam yakol lirot sakkin kede sheyyishchot bah hu beatzmo, veyakol lehashilah laacherim. Veken chakam yakol leharot sakkino lechakam acher, mippene shehechakam yodea shehashchaza asura beyom tob velo yabo lehashchizah.

Veken bizman hazzeh shekkol shochet bodeq hassakkin beatzmo — asur lo libdoq beyom tob, shemma yashchizenna. Veyesh omerim shello aseru leharot hassakkin lechakam mishshum deshemma yashchizenna ella mishshum debimehem lo haya epshar lo lishchot belo reiyyat hechakam et hassakkin apillu im hassakkin yapeh, venimtza reiyyat hechakam lebad hi hammaksheret et hassakkin, vahare zeh domeh qetzat limtaqqen keli, abal bizman hazzeh en reiyyat hassakkin ella kede lebarer hassapeq im yesh bah pegima im lav, venimtza sheen haddabar taluy bareiyya ella bishlemut hassakkin shello hayeta peguma (qodem shehitchil lebodqah), ureiyya zo beatzmah enah maksheret et hassakkin ella mebareret et hassapeq bilbad, velaken en leosrah beyom tob. Vahalaka kisbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bishat haddechaq, kegon shello badaq hassakkin meereb yom tob venitzrak lebasar beyom tob — yesh lismok al sebara haacharona umuttar libdoq hassakkin beyom tob.
Vekol adam apillu eno talmid chakam — muttar libdoq hassakkin achar hashshechita, mishshum deap im yimtzaenna peguma bevadday lo yashchizenna.

Hattabbach yakol leholik hassakkin etzel habbehema apillu derek reshut harabbim. Veken muttar leholik habbehema vehassakkin etzel hattabbach, veen chosheshin shemma yimmalek velo yishchat venimtza tarach beyom tob shello letzorek. Apillu gedi qatan shetztzarik leholik al ketepo, veap al pi shehaya epshar leholiko meetmol, lepi shello gazeru al hahotzaa shehaya epshar laasotah meereb yom tob, mittaam shennitbaer besimman ttz"h.

Behemot sheyyotzeot veroot chutz lattechum ubaot velanot tok hattechum — hare ellu mukanot, veloqechin mehen veshochatin otan beyom tob. Abal behemot haroot velanot chutz lattechum kol yeme haqqayitz, ap shenniknasim labbayit bitchillat yemot haggeshamim, mikkol maqom kol yeme haqqayitz en daat anshe hair alehem vahare hen muqtzin. Veim bau beyom tob lair — en shochatim otan beyom tob im beben hashshemashot hayu chutz lattechum. Ap al pi shebbau lair (mealehem) beyom tob shello middaat hayyisrael — en shochatim otan.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bebehemat yisrael, abal behemot shel nokri — en bahem din muqtzeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"y. Ulepikak nokri shehebi behemot bemaqolin beyom tob, im hebian letzorek nokri, o apillu im hebian setam leir sherubbah nokrim, shekkol hammebi min hassetam letzorek harob hu mebi — hare ellu muttarim apillu im yadua shellanu chutz lattechum, shehare issur muqtzeh en bahem, kevan shehen shel nokri, umishshum shebbau michutz lattechum en lachush, kevan shello hebian letzorek yisrael.

Ap al pi shessepeq muqtzeh asur beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"z — sepeq techumin muttar. Ketzad? Behemot shel nokri shehen regilot lalun chutz lattechum ubeyom tob sheni nimtzeu betok hair — muttar liqqach mehen uleshochotan beyom tob, sheanu tolin lomar meemesh hiknisan letok hattechum vechutz lechomat hair lanu, ulepikak lo rainu otam emesh. Vekol shekken hannimtzaot bair babboqer, shechazaqa meemesh hiknisam letok hattechum.

Egel shennolad beyom tob, im haem omedet laakila — muttar leshochoto beyom tob ap lehaoserin muqtzeh beyom tob, kevan sheimmo mukenet veomedet laakila — hare hu mukan aggab immo, sheim haya rotzeh haya shochet haem qodem shennolad haegel veokel shenehem beyom tob. Vaapillu im yadua shehaem hi terepa, mikkol maqom enah muqtzeh beyom tob, shehare hi mukenet kebar lakkelabim, im ken gam haegel eno muqtzeh, shehare hu mukan meereb yom tob lakkelabim aggab immo, sheim qodem shennolad haya rotzeh letaltel shenehem ulehashlikam lakkelabim haya muttar, vekevan shehaegel mukan lakkelabim muttar gam ken leoklo, shehare eno muqtzeh. Umikkol maqom, tzarik sheyyeda shekkalu lo tishat chodshe haibbur legassa vachamishsha chodashim ledaqqa, kede sheyyetze mittorat nepel, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman t"v. (Veyesh machmirin shetztzarik sheyyapris al gabbe qarqa, kemo sheyyitbaer besamuk).

Ulepi minhag medinot ellu sheen oserin muqtzeh beyom tob ella nolad — yesh lehattir egel shennolad beyom tob apillu im immo omedet legaddel veladot, veen leosro mishshum nolad, kevan shehalleda lo osta shinnuy begupo kelal, shehare ap qodem ledato haya rauy laakila kemo achar shennolad.

Umittaam zeh im hem shabbat veyom tob semukim zeh lezeh venolad beechad mehem — muttar baakila beyom shelleacharayv, ap al pi shehu yom tob o shabbat veen shabbat mekina leyom tob velo yom tob leshabbat (ayyen simman tqy"g), lepi sheen leda zo chashuba hakana, kevan shehaya rauy laakila qodem halleda kemo achar halleda.

Behema shehi mesukkenet vehu yare shemma tamut, im kebar gamar seuddat yom tob veen tzarik lah od beyom tob — asur leshochotah beyom tob, shemmishshum hepsed mamono lo hittiru lo melaka gemura shello letzorek yom tob sheyyesh bah issur min hattora. Abal im en bammelaka issur min hattora, kegon sheyyesh shahut bayyom leekol mibbehema zo kezayit tzali achar shettetze napshah (kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman k"z), ap al pi sheen shahut bayyom kede lebodqah qodem akilat hakkezayit, veap al pi shello yokal shum adam mimmenna kelum beyom tob, mikkol maqom kevan sheyyesh shahut bayyom kede leekol mimmenna kezayit — en issur min hattora leshochotah beyom tob, mippene sheim hayu mizdammenim lo orechim shello akelu adayin hayyom verotzim leekol mibbehema zo — hayeta hashshechita mutteret, im ken shechita zo niqret "meleket okel nepesh", velaken ap sheen lo orechim sherotzim leekol mimmenna, mikkol maqom kevan shehashshechita matteret umaksheret et habbasar sheyyehe rauy leekol beyom tob im yizdammenu lo okelim — en bishchita zo issur min hattora, ella shechakamim asaruha kol sheen bah tzorek yom tob, ubimqom hepsed lo heemidu chakamim et dibrehem.

Umizzeh hattaam hittiru lo gam ken lehapshitah im hu beinyan sheim lo yapshitenna yasriach habbasar, kevan shemmin hattora muttar lehapshitah keshem shemmuttar leshochotah, umin hattaam shennitbaer, ella shechakamim asaruha, velo heemidu chakamim et dibrehem bimqom hepsed.
Umikkol maqom, haor hu nolad kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ttz"t, veasur letaltelo beyom tob, ella im ken shiyyer bo eber echad, sheaz haor batel legabbe haeber umuttar letaltelo immo.

Veyesh omerim shello hittiru lo kelal lehapshitah beyom tob kol sheeno rotzeh leekol mimmenna beyom tob. Veken hashshochet op mippene shehu mesukkan veen dato leekol beyom tob — asur limrot notzato beyom tob. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara harishona, mikkol maqom yesh lehachamir kisbara haacharona.
Hashshochet behema bassadeh — lo yebienna lair bemot o bemota kederek shehu oseh bechol, mishshum zilzul yom tob, ella mebiah beyado ebarim ebarim.

Op shennidras beraglayim veyesh lachush shemma nitrassequ ebarayv, velaken tzarik lehashhoto meet leet veachar kak yishchatennu, veyibdoq oto achar hashshechita shemma nitrassequ ebarayv happenimiyyim, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman n"ch ayyen sham, veim kala kebar hammeet leet muttar leshochoto beyom tob, veen chosheshin shemma yimmatze terepa venimtza asa melaka shello letzorek yom tob, lepi shemmaamidin oto bechezqat hetter, sherob haopot hen kesherim. Umizzeh hattaam muttar lishchot behemot beyom tob ap bemaqom shehatterepot metzuyot kol kak kemo hakkesherot, lepi sheanu holekim achar rob behemot shebbaolam shehen kesherot. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim dibmaqom shehatterepot metzuyot kol kak kemo hakkesherot asur lishchot behema beyom tob, veken op shennidras beraglayim shetztzarik bediqa asur leshochoto beyom tob, shemma yimmatze terepa venimtza sheshshachat shello letzorek yom tob. Ulepi dibrehem egel shennolad beyom tob asur leshochoto beyom tob ella im ken hipris al gabbe qarqa, deshemma al yede shennitrasseq bebet harechem shehu tzar yimmatze bo tarput gamur. Veap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara harishona, mikkol maqom yesh lehachamir kisbara haacharona. Veakshav nahagu haolam shello lishchot behema beyom tob apillu bemaqom sheen hatterepot metzuyin, shemma timmatze terepa. Ulepi shezzehu chumra yetera, laken im tzarik lah beyom tob — yesh lehaqel. Vehu haddin bimqom hepsed, kegon mesukkenet.

Bekor bizman hazzeh sheen yakol leshochoto belo mum — en chakam velo shelosha hedyotot yekolin liroto im yesh bo mum kede lehattiro leshochoto, kevan sheapillu im yesh bo mum velo herahu lechakam o lishlosha hedyotot ushechato — hare zeh asur, veim ken reiyyat hechakam o shelosha hedyotot hi hammatteret et habbekor, vahare zeh domeh limtaqqen. Abal muttar lirot et habbekor velishtoq velo lehattiro. Veap al pi shehu gomer belibbo shehu muttar — en bekak kelum, shehare eno metaqqen kelum.

Im abar veraa hammum shebbo vehittiro — asur leshochoto beyom tob, mippene shehu muqtzeh. Vaapillu lehammattirin muqtzeh beyom tob — modim bemuqtzeh gadol kazeh, shehare etmol vadday hissiach dato mimmennu milleoklo beyom tob, shello haya bedato kelal sheyyaaseh adam issur veyaabor al dibre chakamim sheaseru lehattir bekorot beyom tob. Abal im nolad beyom tob venapal bo mum beyom tob veabar veraa et hammum shebbo vehittiro — muttar leshochoto beyom tob im kalu lo chodashayv, lepi shebben hashshemashot shehu hatchalat kenisat yom tob haya mukan verauy leadam aggab immo, sheillu haya rotzeh haya shochet et immo veokel gam et haubbar shebbemeeha, vekevan shebben hashshemashot lo haya muqtzeh, laken ap shechazar venaasa muqtzeh keshennolad, shehare hissiach dato milleoklo beyom tob mishshum deen mattirin bekorot beyom tob, mikkol maqom kesheabar veraahu vehittiro — hare hu chozer lehettero kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"y deen muqtzeh lachatzi shabbat, ayyen sham, vehu haddin beyom tob.

Im raa hammum meereb yom tob veraa shehu mum qabua sherauy lishchot alayv — yakol lachaqor alayv im napal hammum meelayv umattiro, kevan shehettero hu mechamat reiyyato, vehareiyya hayeta meetmol, im ken kebar nigmar iqqar hahetter meereb yom tob, veeno metaqqen kelum beyom tob.
Bekor shennapal lebor — asur lehaaloto, shehare eno rauy leshochoto beyom tob, vahare hu metaltel dabar sheeno rauy lo beyom tob, ella oseh lo parnasa bimqomo kede shello yamut.

"Oto veet beno" shennapelu lebor — maaleh et harishon al menat leshochoto veeno shochato, vechozer umaarim umaaleh et hashsheni al menat leshochoto, ratza zeh shochet, ratza zeh shochet, demishshum tzaar baale chayyim hittiru lo lehaarim, abal al kol panim tzarik lishchot et achad mehen. Abal im napelu behemot sheenan "oto veet beno" — muttar lehaalotan ap al pi sheeno shochet echad mehen, kevan sheruyot kullam leshochotan hayyom.

Behema shehi chetzyah shel yisrael vechetzyah shel nokri — muttar leshochotah beyom tob, veeno keshochet gam bishbil hannokri, dekevan shei epshar likzayit basar belo shechita — nimtzet kol hashshechita hu tzorek hayyisrael. Vaapillu im yesh lahem shette behemot beshuttaput — yekolin lishchot shettehen, shei epshar lachaloq sheyyittol zeh echad vezeh echad, lepi shei epshar sheyyihyu shavot bekol hainyanim, sheim zo gedola ukechusha vezo qetanna ushemena ap shehen shavot bedamim — yakol lomar: i epshi liqqach kol chelqi biqtanna, o i epshi liqqach kol chelqi bikchusha. Abal im hem shavot legamre bekol hainyanim, vekol shekken im hannokri rotzeh litten lo haggedola vehattoba — asur lishchot et hashsheniyya, shehare epshar lo lechalleq. Abal muttar lo lishchot echad mehen beyom tob ulechalleq otah im hannokri, veachar yom tob yechallequ et hashsheniyya, veen omerim: yishchot hayyisrael behema achat letzorko bilbad belo shuttaput hannokri shehare hen shavot legamre, o shehannokri rotzeh litten haggedola vehattoba, lepi sheen hayyisrael rotzeh lishchot behema shelema letzorko, mippene sheeno tzarik ella lechetzyah, veim tihyeh kullah shello — yippased habbasar.

Hashshochet behema beyom tob — lo yitlosh et hatztzemer shebbimqom shechita kede laasot maqom lassakkin, ap al pi sheen derek geziza bekak vehaoseh kak beshabbat eno chayyab mishshum gozez, mikkol maqom hare hu chayyab mishshum oqer dabar miggiddulo, lepikak asur laasotah beyom tob, shehare en bah tzorek akila, mippene sheepshar lishchot ap im lo yaaseh ken. Veken mizzeh hattaam hashshochet op beyom tob — lo yimrot et hannotza kede laasot maqom lassakkin, shehare hu oqer dabar miggiddulo, veod shehaoseh melaka zo beshabbat yesh lechayyebo gam mishshum gozez, shehare ken derek haop litlosh notzato beyad. Abal muttar lepannot hatztzemer o hannotza mimmeqom hashshechita al yede sheyyimshekem beyado elak vaelak, ubilbad shello yitkavven litlosh, veim nitlash meelayv — en bekak kelum, shehare hu eno mitkavven lekak, vedabar sheeno mitkavven muttar apillu beissure tora. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmepanneh beyado, abal asur lepannot al yede sakkin o keli acher, mippene shei epshar lo lizzaher heteb shello yitlosh, veqarob levadday sheyyitlosh, ulepikak ap al pi sheeno mitkavven lekak asur, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"k. Vaapillu im i epshar lo lishchot ella im ken talash hatztzemer o hannotza beyado, o al yede sheyyepanneh otam al yede sheyyimshekem elak veelak al yede keli — ap al pi ken asur laasotan beyom tob, mippene shemmelakot ellu rob peamim epshar laasotan meereb yom tob, ayyen simman ttz"h.

Eper kira shehussaq meereb yom tob — muttar letaltelo beyom tob, mippene shehu mukan lekol tzorke haadam: lekassot bo roq o tzoa, o dam chayya vaop. Abal im hussaq beyom tob — asur letaltelo. Veap hammattirim benolad modim benolad gadol kazeh demaaseh chadash hu, sheetmol haya etzim veakshav eper. Veim hissiq beyom tob etzim al gabbe eper shel etmol venitareb eper shel hayyom beeper shel etmol beinyan sheeper shel hayyom lo haya nikkar meolam bipne atzmo — hare hu batel berob, veen danin kan din "dabar sheyyesh lo mattirin", kevan shemmeolam lo niqra alayv shem issur, shehare bitchillat havayato nitbattel berob beeper shel etmol.

Eper kira shehussaq beyom tob vehu adayin cham sherauy litzlot bo betza — muttar letaltelo lekol tzorke haadam, shehare hu omed verauy limlakto harishona shehaya rauy lah keshehaya etzim, dehaynu laapiyya ulebishshul. Veken im nitztannen vechazar vehucham — muttar letaltelo.
Gechalim omemot asur letaltelan beyom tob apillu nitammemu meereb yom tob, shehare enan reuyim liklum.

Im hiknis meereb yom tob apar harbeh letzorek ginnato o letzorek churbato vehu kanus vetzabur bemaqom echad — muttar letaltelo, lepi sheeno muqtzeh kelal, shekkol zeman shehu tzabur dato alayv lekol mah sheyyitztarek. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehiknis apar harbeh sheeno batel aggab qarqa hagginna vehachurba, abal im hiknis melo quppato apar ushetachah beqarqait hagginna o hachurba, meachar sheheapar muat — hare hu batel legabbe haqqarqa veasur letaltelo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beginna vechurba, abal im hiknis meereb yom tob melo quppato apar veera et heapar beqarqait hechatzer o habbayit — eno batel legabbe haqqarqa umuttar letaltelo, vehu sheyyiched lo qeren zavit, dekevan shello shetacho beemtza hechatzer vehabbayit lemirmas raglayim — nikkar haddabar shechapetz bo laasot tzerakayv vedato alayv lekol mah sheyyitztarek.

Bammeh debarim amurim demuttar letaltelo lekol mah sheyyitztarek? Keshehikniso bistam, demin hassetam dato lekol mah sheyyitztarek lemachar. Abal im hikniso meereb yom tob kede lekassot bo dam chayya vaop sheyyishchot lemachar — asur lekassot bo tzoa, shehare etmol keshehekin et heapar lo haya yodea sheyyaaseh hattinoq tzerakayv bemaqom hammaus sheyyitztarek lekassot tzoato, velo hayeta kavvanato behaknasato et heapar ella lekassot dam chayya vaop shebbarur lo sheyyishchot lemachar, vehammekin ledabar shevvadday lo — en hakanato moelet letzorek dabar shessapeq lo bishat hakana, veken kol kayyotze bazeh.

Bammeh debarim amurim demuttar letaltel apar beyom tob? Kesheheapar tichuach kol kak sheeno oseh guma bintilato, shemmiyyad shennotel heapar nopel apar acher tachtayv limqomo. Abal im eno tichuach kol kak, apillu hu talush venatun bikli — asur littelo min hakkeli, shello yaaseh guma beheapar. Veap al pi shehi melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, shehare eno tzarik lehagguma atzmah ella laaparah, umin hattora en chayyabim al melaka kazo, mikkol maqom lekattechilla asur laasotah middibre soperim. Abal muttar littelo beinyan shello yaaseh guma beapar, kegon shehu tzabur keen har — muttar littelo min rosh hashshippua.

Mi sheyyesh lo eper harauy letaltelo o apar tichuach mukan meereb yom tob beinyan shemmuttar littelo beyom tob veal derek shennitbaer — hare zeh shochet chayya vaop beyom tob umekasseh damam. Umuttar litten apar o eper lematta qodem hashshechita kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman k"ch, veen chosheshin shemma achar kak yimmalek velo yishchot venimtza tarach shello letzorek.

Abal im en lo apar o eper hareuyim letiltul — hare zeh lo yishchot. Veim abar veshachat, im yesh lo eper kira shehussaq beyom tob, o apar sheeno mukan vehu tichuach kol kak ad sheen naaseh guma bintilato mimmeqomo — muttar lekassot bahem, mippene shemmitzvat kissuy shehi min hattora docheh issur tiltul muqtzeh sheeno ella middibrehem.

Veim en lo eper shehussaq beyom tob velo apar tichuach harbeh, ella apar tichuach meat vehu munnach al gabbe apar qasheh beinyan sheim yittol qetzat min heapar yishshaer guma bimqom netilato, im zeh heapar hu mukan meereb yom tob, kegon shettelasho min haqqarqa vehinnicho bachatzero kede lekassot bo beyom tob, o apillu im hu mechubbar laqqarqa ella shennaatz bo deqer meereb yom tob kede lekassot bo beyom tob — hare hizmin oto letzorek yom tob veen bo mishshum muqtzeh, ulepikak muttar lekassot bo im kebar abar veshachat. Veim lo naatz ella deqer echad ulemachar nitzrak lidqirot harbeh mippene sheshshachat harbeh — muttar lidqor kamma deqirot beyom tob baapar tichuach shennaatz bo haddeqer beereb yom tob, shehare kebar hekino lekak meereb yom tob. Veap al pi sheyyesh kan issur asiyyat guma, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno asur ella middibrehem kemo shennitbaer — lo heemidu et dibrehem bimqom mitzvat kissuy. Abal im lo naatz bo deqer meereb yom tob kede lahakino letzorek yom tob — asur lekassot bo beyom tob apillu kebar abar veshachat, kevan sheyyesh kan shene issurim: issur asiyyat guma veissur tiltul muqtzeh — lo ratzu chakamim lebattel dibrehem kol kak, veyesh koach beyad hachakamim laaqor dabar min hattora be"sheb veal taaseh".

Vaapillu im naatz deqer beapar hammechubbar laqqarqa shehu tichuach kol kak ad sheen naaseh guma bintilato mimmeqomo — ap al pi ken lekattechilla asur lishchot chayya vaop beyom tob im en lo eper o apar acher mukan, mippene shenneitzat haddeqer en oseh hakana gemura. Veen somekin aleha ella im ken kebar abar veshachat.

Im kebar abar veshachat veen lo ella gush apar sheen rauy lekassot bo ad sheyyikteshennu kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman k"ch — hare zeh lo yikteshennu beyom tob min hattora, sheen mitzvat aseh shel kissuy haddam docheh et lo taaseh shel yom tob sheyyesh bah aseh velo taaseh, shehare neemar bah "shabbaton", kelomar: shebot mimmelaka, vezohi mitzvat aseh.

Koy, shehu sepeq chayya vedamo taun kissuy, sapeq shehu behema veen damo taun kissuy — en shochatin oto beyom tob. Veim abar ushechato — en mekassin et damo beyom tob apillu yesh lo eper o apar tichuach mukan meereb yom tob, mippene haroim, shello yabou lehattir chelbo, sheyyomru: vadday chayya hu, deim lo ken lo hayu matrichin missapeq lekassot damo beyom tob. Umizzeh hattaam asur leshochoto letok hakkeli velitten apar meat letok hakkeli leqabbel bo haddam kede lekassoto laereb, ap al pi shebbechol muttar laasot ken kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman y"a, mikkol maqom beyom tob asur laasot ken, shello yabou haroim lehattir chelbo. Veim abar ushechato beyom tob venibla haddam baqqarqa, im rishshumo nikkar bemotzae yom tob — tzarik lekassoto, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman k"ch. Bammeh debarim amurim sheen mekassin et damo beyom tob? Kesheshshechato beqeren zavit vekayyotze bazeh maqom sheen bo derisat haregel tamid, abal im shechato beemtza hechatzer — apillu dam behema yakol lekassot im yesh lo eper o apar mukan, mippene shehu tzarik lekassot kede shello yitlakleku kelayv bechatzer, velaken gam haroeh shemmekasseh dam hakkoy lo yiteh lehattir chelbo, ki yodea hu gam ken shehu oseh lenaqqer chatzero.

Shachat koy vechayya vaop o behema vechayya vaop venitarebu damam zeh bazeh beinyan shechayyab bekissuy kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman k"ch, im hu beinyan sheim lo hayu haddamim meorabim haya mekasseh dam chayya vaop beyom tob, kegon sheyyesh lo deqer nautz meereb yom tob, veen tzarik lomar im yesh lo eper o apar tichuach harbeh mukan meereb yom tob — hare zeh mekasseh kol taarobet haddamim beyom tob. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheyyakol lekassot et hakkol bimat deqirot, beinyan sheap im lo haya tzarik ella lekassot et dam hachayya vaop bilbad haya tzarik lekol kak deqirot, abal im en yakol lekassot kol dam hattaarobot ella al yede deqirot harbeh yoter mimmah shehaya tzarik ledam chayya vaop bilbad — asur laasot apillu deqira achat, vaapillu beeper o baapar tichuach mukan meereb yom tob, deshemma lo yekasseh dam hammechuyyab bekissuy, venimtza toreach beyom tob shello letzorek. Veen tzarik lomar sheasur lekassot et kol dam hattaarobet, shehare bevadday hu toreach shello letzorek.

Shachat chayya vaop beereb yom tob velo kissa damam — asur lekassotam beyom tob apillu beapar mukan, shehare ap im lo yekasseh — yehe muttar leoklam beyom tob, venimtza toreach shello letzorek yom tob mah shehaya epshar laasotah meereb yom tob.

Hashshochet chayya vaop beyom tob al gabbe qarqa qasheh veshakach velo natan apar tichuach lematta, ap al pi shebbechol tzarik ligror et haddam velitteno al apar tichuach ulekassoto kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman k"ch, mikkol maqom beyom tob en laasot ken im nityabbesh haddam qetzat, lepi sheyyesh bekan melaka gemura shennotel gabshushit meal haaretz, ubeshabbat chayyab mishshum boneh, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"b.
